purpose: Exact extraction of existing frozen QQQ confirmation results for the fully invested USD ETF/TQQQ portfolio; no rerun or parameter selection.

method.sellRule: QQQ below 200-day SMA and at least 20% below trailing 252-observation high for 20 consecutive QQQ observations; sell TQQQ only on next common close.
method.reentryRule: QQQ above 200-day SMA for 3 consecutive observations; reinvest its after-tax reserve on next common close.

units.yearEqualCAGRpp: percentage points, entry-year-equal average of paired account CAGR differences

scopeNotes: These results are from actual US-listed USD and TQQQ ETF prices, converted to CNY, with QQQ as signal proxy. USD is an ETF ticker, not the currency.
The 81 ten-year and 21 fifteen-year accounts overlap; they are not independent trials.
The archived strategy was selected after repeated research; these are historical comparisons, not untouched holdout evidence or a future guarantee.
Fully invested cash-topup equals its lump baseline exactly; only the separate QQQ strategy can explain the full-investment outperformance here.
Production audit records the earlier model SHA at audit time. Later changes to cash-topup execution and QQQ display metadata do not change these archived research account results.
Stress extra delay 1 is the archived QQQ stress convention and must not be equated with the new cash-topup pending-order delay convention.
